rca of the issue: RCA — CreateListingPage.js: A reference to `isQuebecListing` exists in JSX (likely a conditional render for the Bill 96 helper/asterisk), but the symbol was never declared in scope. The page is wrapped in an error boundary that shows the 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay; nothing below the crash point renders, which is why title-fr-input is absent. Reproduction: navigate to /create-listing while authenticated → red overlay appears immediately. Fix: import/derive `isQuebecListing` from province state (e.g., `const isQuebecListing = useMemo(() => province === 'QC', [province])`) or replace with the canonical helper from /app/frontend/src/utils/bill96.js.
